data.title: Hop and Jump Number Line Fun
data.description: Practice adding and subtracting using two fun hops on the number line.

challenges.instruction: Start your first jump at 16 and subtract 2. Then, take another jump from where you land to reach your final spot!
challenges.hint: Think about which direction each jump goes. Count your hops carefully!

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 20. Make your first hop by subtracting 1. Then, take your second hop from where you landed to finish your journey!
challenges.hint: Remember, subtracting means hopping backwards to the left. Think about how many steps you need to take for that second hop.

challenges.instruction: Start your journey at 29. Take a big backward hop of 4, and then hop again from right where you land to finish your adventure!
challenges.hint: Count backwards 4 hops first to find your first stop, then think about which way you need to hop next.

challenges.instruction: Put your frog on 27! First, hop backward 4 spaces. Then, from right where you land, take another hop until you reach your final spot.
challenges.hint: Check which direction each jump goes. Count your hops carefully from where you are standing!
